subject: Encryption evidence matrix + request to demo HSM rotation process
messages:
From: Alex Hunter <alex.hunter@finmed.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Team <security@finmed.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: encryption artifacts + HSM rotation demo

Hi Aditya,

We are ramping our SIG/CAIQ review and the security reviewers asked for a consolidated mapping of Redwood's encryption controls to SIG/CAIQ/SOC2 sections. In particular they want:
- a simple evidence matrix (artifact -> evidence type + where to find it)
- recent key rotation logs for KMS/HSM (last 12 months)
- operator shift / custody logs for HSM ceremonies
- confirmation of TLS at-rest and in-transit cipher suites and proof of config

Also, their auditor would like a short live demo of your HSM rotation process (we're OK with a recorded walkthrough but they'd prefer a live Q&A). Can you confirm what you can provide and propose next steps?

CC'ing our security inbox so they have visibility. Natalie from their audit firm will join if we schedule a demo.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Hunter
Head of Engineering Security, FinMed Health
alex.hunter@finmed.com

Attachments: none
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hunter <alex.hunter@finmed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Security Team <security@finmed.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption artifacts + HSM rotation demo

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver the matrix and the artifacts, and we can run a 30–45 minute live demo of the HSM rotation with Q&A (or provide a recorded walkthrough plus live Q&A if scheduling is tight).

Planned deliverables:
1) Encryption evidence matrix (CSV) that maps SIG/CAIQ controls -> Redwood artifact name -> access link + last modified date.
2) Key rotation logs (signed timeline + operator IDs) covering the last 12 months.
3) Operator shift logs and ceremony minutes (redacted where needed).
4) Rotation runbook and post-rotation verification checklist (PDF).
5) A 20–30 minute demo: HSM rotation sequence (operator steps, challenge-response, wrap/unwrap checks), followed by auditor Q&A.

Marissa — can you assemble the artifacts and upload them to a share with short README? Irene / Ben — please prepare the demo script and the short recording excerpt we can show if the auditor requests it.

Alex — what timezone window looks best next week for a live session? We can do Wed/Thu mornings PST or afternoons EST.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Attachments (for internal planning): rotation_runbook_v2.pdf (attachment), demo_script_outline.txt (attachment)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption artifacts + HSM rotation demo

Aditya — I've started the evidence package. Summary of what I've uploaded to the shared folder (link below):

- kms_encryption_evidence_matrix.csv — maps SIG v1.10 / CAIQ entries to our artifacts (column headers: control_id, control_text, redwood_artifact, artifact_type, link, last_modified).
- rotation_runbook_v2.pdf — runbook and verification checklist (includes exact CLI commands and API calls we use to seal/unseal).
- operator_shift_logs_20280228.zip — compressed shift logs with audit timestamps and operator IDs (redacted PII).
- hsm_rotation_walkthrough.mp4 — 12-min recorded walkthrough we can play if they prefer recorded first.
- kms_iam_policy_snapshot.txt — snapshot of CMK IAM roles and grants.
- tls_config_summary.txt — cipher suites (TLS1.2+, recommended ciphers) and references to our load balancer config.

Notes / caveats:
- The rotation logs are signed by our HSM vendor attestation and include hash digests. We will deliver a hash manifest in the folder.
- For SIG/CAIQ mapping some items point to combined artifacts (e.g., runbook + logs) — I added a short note column in the CSV.
- If the auditor needs raw HSM audit trail exports we can coordinate with the vendor but that requires an NDA amendment; I flagged that in the README.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bfc-demo-evidence

Ben — I'll need the short demo script and the list of operator names you plan to have on call. Irene — can you confirm whether we are comfortable sharing unredacted operator IDs with FinMed or prefer a redacted extract?

Marissa Cole
Security Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: kms_encryption_evidence_matrix.csv (attachment), hsm_rotation_walkthrough.mp4 (attachment)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Hunter <alex.hunter@finmed.com>, Natalie Voss <natalie.voss@auditfirm.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@finmed.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Mar 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: encryption artifacts + HSM rotation demo

Alex / Natalie — thanks for the patience. We uploaded the evidence folder and prepared a short agenda for the live session. Proposed slot: Wed Mar 22, 2028 at 10:00 AM PST / 1:00 PM EST (30 minutes). Please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m: Quick intro + scope (what artifacts correspond to SIG/CAIQ categories)
- 12m: Live walkthrough of HSM rotation (operator steps, wrap/unwrap verification, signed rotation log review)
- 8m: Review of evidence matrix and where to find artifacts (CSV -> runbook -> logs)
- 5m: Q&A / next steps (additional exports, NDA amendment if they request raw HSM exports)

What we're sharing now: kms_encryption_evidence_matrix.csv, rotation_runbook_v2.pdf, operator_shift_logs_20280228.zip, hsm_rotation_walkthrough.mp4, tls_config_summary.txt. Access link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bfc-demo-evidence

On items likely to come up:
- Key rotation frequency: automated monthly for ephemeral KEKs; yearly for tenant CMKs with emergency rekey procedures documented in the runbook.
- At-rest encryption: tenant data encrypted with customer-seeded CMKs; we provide key usage proofs and sampling of ciphertext headers in the evidence folder.
- In-transit: TLS 1.2+ with forward secrecy; load balancer and runtime configs included.
- HSM details: vendor attestation included; operator access is gated by MFA + signed ceremony; ceremony logs are time-stamped and signed.

If you confirm the slot we'll send a calendar invite and a short participant list. If the auditor prefers a recorded-first approach, feel free to review the MP4 and we'll still keep the live Q&A for clarifications.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Attachments: kms_encryption_evidence_matrix.csv (link), rotation_runbook_v2.pdf (link), hsm_rotation_walkthrough.mp4 (link)
